text: うわさずきの　おまえには　それが　ピッタリ　だぜ！

structure.jp: うわさずきの　おまえには
それが　ピッタリ　だぜ！

patterns.name: 〜には
patterns.explanation: には after a person says 'for that person', pointing out who something suits. おまえには = 'for you'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky boys' talk that pushes the statement at the listener. ピッタリ だぜ = 'it's a perfect fit, I tell you!'
